integrity: Finite computations are consistency checks only; the infinite statement is proved structurally from homogeneity, quantifier-free nested-equivalence patterns, and Morley-rank induction.
scientific_limitations: The higher-order Bell numbers and their nested-partition interpretation are prior; novelty is restricted to the exact orbit-profile realization and Morley-rank calibration for the canonical nested-equivalence tower. No extremality among all rank-r monadically stable structures is claimed.
title: Higher-order Bell orbit profiles calibrate the finite Morley-rank equivalence tower
